description: A patient takes anxiety medication and anti-depressants one after the other. Each unit of anxiety medication takes 3 minutes to be effective while each unit of anti-depressant takes 5 minutes to be effective. The patient must take at least 100 units of medication and at least 30 should be anxiety medication. Since the anxiety medication is strong, the patient can take at most twice the amount of anxiety medication as anti-depressants. How many units of each should the patient take to minimize the total time it take for the medication to be effective?

TimePerAnxietyUnit.definition: Time it takes for one unit of anxiety medication to be effective

TimePerAntidepressantUnit.definition: Time it takes for one unit of anti-depressant to be effective

MinimumTotalUnits.definition: Minimum total units of medication the patient must take

MinimumAnxietyUnits.definition: Minimum units of anxiety medication the patient must take

MaximumAnxietyToAntidepressantRatio.definition: Maximum ratio of anxiety medication units to anti-depressant units

objective.description: "Minimize the total time required for the medication to be effective"

AnxietyUnits.definition: Number of units of anxiety medication taken by the patient

AntidepressantUnits.definition: Number of units of anti-depressant medication taken by the patient
